# Confirm mouse recovery preserves every draft selection

## What & Why
Mouse recovery should restore the same complete draft as keyboard recovery. A regression could reset an answer category or an opportunity's status and priority while the visible text still looks correct.

## Done looks like
- Recovering an answer draft with the mouse preserves its selected category.
- Recovering an opportunity draft with the mouse preserves its status and priority.
- The assertions sit beside the existing mouse recovery coverage.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
